# QARM

> QARM (Quality Assistance & Relationship Management) combines CRM automation, growth systems, and managed operations — for mortgage, real estate, financial services, and other relationship-driven professionals across Canada and the United States, with additional operations support in the UK, UAE, and Australia.

QARM is not a virtual assistant agency or generic outsourcing service. It is a structured operations organization staffed by trained specialists, combining human execution with AI-enhanced automation across four connected pillars: AI & CRM Automation, Growth & Marketing, Sales & Appointment Support, and Managed Operations. Mortgage operations remain QARM's founding specialization, extending naturally to real estate, financial services, and other pipeline-based industries.

## Services
- [Services](https://www.theqarm.com/services): AI & CRM automation, growth marketing, sales & appointment support, managed operations, document/condition fulfillment, compliance operations
- [Industries](https://www.theqarm.com/industries): QARM's operating model applied across mortgage & lending, real estate, financial services & insurance, and professional services
- [Mortgage & Lending](https://www.theqarm.com/mortgage): QARM's founding specialization — CRM, file, and client support for mortgage brokers and agents. Supporting clients across Canada, the United States, and selected international markets.
- [Real Estate](https://www.theqarm.com/real-estate): CRM, listing coordination, and client follow-up for real estate professionals
- [Financial Services & Insurance](https://www.theqarm.com/financial-services): CRM, policy and file coordination, and client communication for advisors and agents
- [Professional Services](https://www.theqarm.com/professional-services): CRM, client communication, and scheduling for consultants and service-based professionals
- [Pricing](https://www.theqarm.com/pricing): Transparent part-time and full-time operations support plans, no setup fees, no lock-in contracts
- [Broker Growth Services](https://www.theqarm.com/broker-growth): Websites, SEO, and social media management for mortgage, real estate, and financial services professionals

## Company
- [About](https://www.theqarm.com/about): Founded 2023, based in Toronto, Canada. Operates across Canada, the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and UAE.
- [Contact](https://www.theqarm.com/contact): info@theqarm.com
